Lowers the odds of tokens the answer already has, so a long reasoning does not go round in circles.
Photos and pictures in the chat. Off: the vision encoder is not loaded, which saves memory.
Videos in the chat: the model watches their frames and hears their sound.
Voice messages and audio files. Off: the audio encoder is not loaded, which saves memory.
The model\'s MTP layer drafts the next word and the model checks two at once: faster answers, the same text. Off: one word at a time.
Gemma\'s drafter guesses the next words and the model checks them at once: faster answers, the same text. Off: one word at a time, and the drafter\'s memory saved.
Recommended for %1$s in this mode: temperature %2$.2f, top-p %3$.2f, top-k %4$d, presence penalty %5$.1f.
This model was trained for up to %1$d tokens of context.
After this many reasoning tokens the model is told to answer now.
Little cores join the big ones on long prompts. On the Redmi Note 9 Pro they made prompts slower.
While a layer computes, reads the experts the next one is predicted to need.

Which of the phone\'s processors run the model. With two, the first reads the prompts and the second writes the answer. Only the processors this phone has are listed; the default, NPU + GPU, is the fastest where both are there.
Faster answers when the model does not fit in memory
Prefers experts already in memory, so fewer are read from storage. Answers may change a little in wording and occasionally in quality. Off by default.

8 (default): every expert the model picks, its full quality. 6 or 4: when one of the last 2 or 4 picked experts is not in memory, it is skipped instead of read. Faster when the model does not fit in memory, but the model\'s answers become less accurate.
Changing these opens the model again with the next question.
The model stopped while still reasoning, with no answer. Low-bit packs (Q2) often do; a Q3 pack reasons properly.
No saved chats yet: a chat is saved with its first question.
The model is summarizing the conversation…
Earlier messages were removed after the context was compressed: the model goes on from its summary of them.
From here on the model sees this summary instead of the messages above it.

How finely the model sees an attached image: up to 256, 576 or 1024 of its tokens. Finer reads small text better but takes longer before the answer starts (the image is encoded on the phone\'s cores; its weights are read from storage only then).
The model keeps working while the app is in the background.
Needs %1$s of free space; %2$s is free
Fast on this phone: its GPU does the work
No GPU acceleration on this chip: it runs on the processor, a few words a second
%1$s of RAM: it runs, but slowly
The agent works in its own Linux on this phone. Give it skills and tools (MCP servers) here: every chat with the agent on gets them.
Not set up yet: it unpacks the first time the agent is turned on in a chat.
This version of Geode brings a newer Linux: it is updated the next time the agent starts (your chats\' files stay).
Set up and up to date.

Instructions the agent follows when a task calls for them: a SKILL.md (a name and a description at its top, then what to do), alone or in a folder with its scripts. A chat\'s own skills can also live in its folder, in .agents/skills.
No skills of your own yet.
No skill there: a SKILL.md needs a name and a description at its top
Tools from Model Context Protocol servers: a command run in the agent\'s Linux (npx, python3, uvx and the like), or a server on the internet.
It runs in each chat\'s Linux, from the chat\'s folder; what it needs (npm, pip packages) is installed there the first time.
In a chat with the agent on, a message that starts with / is a command: /compact shortens the conversation so far to a summary (the agent remembers the gist and reads less).

What the model has read of a conversation is kept, so it goes on at once after a pause, another chat or a restart, instead of reading everything again (and a system prompt every conversation shares is read once). Now taken: %1$s.
The answer ran into its length limit.

The agent opens web pages and the pages it makes in the phone\'s browser: it runs their scripts, reads their console and takes screenshots. You watch it in the chat and can open it on the whole screen.
This chat\'s folder: the agent works in it (/workspace), you can add files for it.
A new chat that goes on from here apart: the messages and the agent\'s Linux with its files are copied.
The local server is answering a request: your question is next.
The agent is answering this chat for the web chat…

Programs on this network use the model through the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs at once: chat apps, code editors, scripts, agents. It answers with the model selected here and the settings of the chat, one request at a time; a conversation that goes on is not read again.
Port %1$d is taken by another app: choose another one below.
No local network: connect to Wi-Fi or turn on the hotspot.
No model selected: requests get an error until one is.
Your chats in the browser of a computer or another phone on this network: read them, go on with them, start new ones. It asks for the password below.
Point the camera at the QR code on the web chat\'s sign-in page
%1$s will see all your chats and can go on with them. Sign it in only if it is your own browser.
This QR code is not valid any more: reload the sign-in page in the browser.
The web chat is off: turn it on on the Local server screen.

Too many wrong passwords: wait a minute.
Scan it with Geode on your phone: %1$s → %2$s
Without a key any device on the network can use the model.
1024–65535: the ports an app can open without root. A running server moves to the new port at once.

Local network only: the server answers devices on this Wi-Fi, the phone\'s hotspot or USB tethering; nothing goes through the internet. While the server is on the phone does not sleep - turn it off from the notification.
A big AI model on your phone

Tell the developer what is wrong with it. Reports help make the model\'s answers safer.

Instead of the code. A fingerprint added to the phone later turns this off.
Add a fingerprint in the phone\'s settings first.
The phone\'s fingerprints changed, so the fingerprint is off: unlock with the code and turn it on again in Settings.
While the lock is on, the app\'s preview in recent apps is hidden. The web chat and the API on the network keep their own password and key.
Without the code there is no other way in: every chat goes, with its photos, sounds and the agent\'s files, and then the lock. The models stay.
The messages and the input in the chat. Two fingers on the conversation change it too.
Black screen after %1$d min without a touch

Against burn-in: on an OLED screen the parts of the picture that never move (the bars, the input) can burn in over hours. The black screen is not a lock: the phone stays unlocked, and a touch on the screen brings Geode back.
With the black screen off, a picture that stays still for hours can burn into an OLED screen for good.
Touch the screen to come back
Runs on the processor (the NPU reads prompts where there is one), on phones with 8 GB of RAM or more
%1$s of RAM: too little for this model (it wants 8 GB)
Sentence by sentence as the answer is written. The speaker under an answer reads it again.

This is how the answers will sound.

Supertonic 3: 31 languages read on this phone, Ukrainian, Russian and English among them; other languages are read by the phone\'s text-to-speech. It stays on the storage and takes about 300 MB of memory only while it reads.
Supertonic 3 by Supertone, under the Open RAIL-M licence: its use restrictions apply to what it reads. Run with sherpa-onnx.

Folders of this phone that every chat\'s agent can work with: in its Linux they are at /phone. The agent works on a copy of each, brought up to date before every message; a read-and-write folder gets the agent\'s changes back when it is done. Taking a folder back deletes only the copy.
Not copied: %1$d (a copy holds at most 10,000 files and %2$s)
The folder could not be given to the agent

The model of a service you have a key for can answer the chats instead of the phone\'s own: DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any service that speaks their APIs. What the chats send goes to that service; the agent\'s Linux and its files stay on the phone.
Kept on this phone, encrypted. Type a new one to replace it.
Chats with this model are sent to %1$s and handled under its terms. The key stays on this phone, encrypted.
Ask anything. The answers come from %1$s (%2$s): what you send leaves the phone.
And when you choose a service\'s model on the Models screen, its chats are sent to that service.
The song could not be made
The song model is not on this phone yet. Download it in the Music settings (about 5.5 GB).
In English: the language first, then the genre, the voice, the instruments, the mood and the tempo. For example: English, indie pop, warm female voice, acoustic guitar, 96 BPM
The model writes a score with the melody and the chords first, then sings and plays it: the usual choice, the best songs.
The score has the melody only: the accompaniment is freer.
No score: the song starts sooner and has less structure.
The tune and the chords on the phone\'s MIDI synthesizer - not the song\'s sound.

The ABC score the model sings: the melody, the chords and the key. A new key moves every note and chord with it, and the take is sung anew from its first note. An edit the score format cannot read is refused before anything is sung.
Tap a note to select it, or an empty place to put one there. Drag a note to move it; drag elsewhere to scroll.
A part sings one note at a time: that place is taken.
That would leave the score\'s bars.
The voice\'s middle leaves C4 to A#5, where the model\'s own scores keep it.

[Verse]
The first line of the song
The second line

[Chorus]
The chorus

Section puts a tag such as [Chorus] on a line of its own. Pause puts an [Interlude]: the band plays and the voice rests. Stress turns the letter before the cursor into a capital (or back): a capital inside a word shows the model the stressed vowel, as in ФраголІно. No lyrics make an instrumental.
The same words sung anew each time, with its own seed: keep the one that sounds best.
Only the tunes are written, in a fraction of the time: listen to them, then sing the one you like.
This MIDI file cannot be sung: %1$s
it is not a MIDI file, or it is damaged.
it is timed in video frames, not in beats, so it has no bars.
it has no tune to sing (no notes, or drums only).
it is longer than any song.
its notes cannot be written as a score.
The tempo moves between %1$s and %2$s BPM: the score keeps the average, %3$s BPM.
The notes were played in by hand, off the beat grid: they were rounded to the nearest sixteenth.
The vocal line (track %1$s) was moved %2$s semitones into the singer\'s range.
The instrument line (track %1$s) was moved %2$s semitones into the model\'s range.
Track %1$s plays chords: of the notes struck together the top one was kept (%2$s dropped).
The chords were guessed from what the parts play together.
The chords were read from track %1$s (%2$s).
Track %1$s plays notes that make no chord the score can name (bars %2$s).
The tune names no sections, so the lyrics are laid along it: %1$s. The song ends about %2$s s in.
Not sung: bars %1$s of the tune.
The tune has about %1$s notes for each syllable (phrases of about %2$s notes, lines of about %3$s syllables): the model may sing sounds of its own on the notes left over.
The lyrics have more syllables than the tune has notes (phrases of about %1$s notes, lines of about %2$s syllables): the model may crowd or drop words.
Written by %1$s (the Music settings change it)

A summer night by the sea, two friends who will not meet again
The model answered twice with no lyrics in it. Write again, or choose another model in the Music settings.
The lyrics are longer or shorter than asked for: so will the song be.
The style names no tempo: the model picks one.
No section tags: the song will be one block. Add [Verse] and [Chorus].
No songs yet. Write one on the Create tab.
New take on the same melody
Tap a bar, or drag across bars, to select them. The bars are estimated from the song\'s score.
Drag across the waveform to select a stretch of the song.
At the start or the end: trimmed at once, with a fade.
Inside the song: the seam is sung again around the cut, about %1$s on this phone.
Select less: at least a second of the song has to stay.
Sing again: the same words from a new seed; its length may move by up to %1$s so it joins the song where the song goes on best. About %2$s on this phone.
From bar %1$d (%2$s): the model writes the rest of the score for the new lines, then sings on and ends the song itself. No lines: just a new ending. About %3$s; known once its score is written.
Tap the first and the last line to rewrite, then select the bars they are sung in. The tune stays the same.
The new lines have %1$d syllables where the old ones had %2$d: the tune stays the same, so they may not fit it.
The cut takes the words of %1$s out of the song.
the lines before the first tag
The cut reaches the end of the song, which stops short of its score, so bars %1$d to %2$d go with it.
The lyrics\' sections could not be paired with the score\'s, so the words stay as they are.
This song cannot go on here: it has no score, or its bars no longer match its score (a song cut by an older version).
Select whole sections, then the section they should go before. The stretch before each new join is sung again.
The lines before the first tag get a [Verse] tag: they no longer open the song.
The song now starts with %1$s, not with its own start: it fades in.
The song now ends with %1$s, not with its own ending: it fades out.
Joins sung again: %1$d, two takes each (the better join kept). About %2$s on this phone.
An instrumental break put in before a section: the model writes its bars, then plays them. It may still sing a little in it.
It goes in at %1$s; its bars are written first. About %2$s on this phone.
Delete %1$s? Its file goes as well.

The song reached its length limit and was cut there.
YuE2-3B and its sound decoder: the whole song - the score, the voice, the band - is made on the phone. It is kept apart from the chat\'s models.

The YuE2 model is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0: the songs are for non-commercial use.
With the instrumental adapter: the model writes its own score with a plan of sections and plays it, with no voice.
Needs the instrumental adapter (133 MB): download it in Music settings.
Empty: the model chooses the sections and the length. Or one tag a line: [intro], [verse], [chorus]… Times work too: [verse 0:15-0:45].
In English: the genre, the instruments, the mood and the tempo - no language, no voice. For example: synthwave, analog synth lead, drum machine, deep bass, 110 BPM
A LoRA for the song model\'s writing stage: instrumental music with a plan of sections. The first song with it merges it into a copy of the model\'s weights (a few minutes).
Download %1$s; about %2$s more when it is first used.
By Mothersuperior, m-a-p/YuE2-3B; CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial). Geode merges it into the weights on the phone.
Delete %1$s (%2$s)? It can be downloaded again.

How closely the song follows the style and the lyrics. 1.2 makes words about the arrangement count (the bass dropping out before the chorus), but the tempo may drift. Above 1 composing takes twice as long.
32 is what the model was made for. Fewer steps are faster and sound worse.
The score and the music codes from 4-bit weights: about a fifth faster, noticeably less precise - an experiment. Made once from the installed model (1.1 GB more).
The sound as the model computes it, nothing rounded further. The slowest choice on phones without the NPU.

The default. On phones without the NPU the attention\'s scores in 8 bits: the sound a few percent faster (more in long songs), the difference about a third of the model\'s own rounding noise. On the NPU the same as Best.
Also 8-bit weights: on phones without the NPU the sound about a third faster (on the NPU a few percent), noticeably less precise - an experiment. Made once from the installed model (1.5 GB more).
The model decides when the song ends; this is the most it may run. From the lyrics: 12 s a sung line, at least 40 s, 3 minutes for an instrumental.
Every take is different. Off: the same seed each time (the same settings give a similar song, not the same one).
The values the model was made with, for the score and for the sound.

The longest stage. The NPU takes it where it has the matrix unit (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 and newer); on other Snapdragons the GPU does its products, elsewhere the processor computes it all, slowly: start with a short song.
The chat\'s model is closed while a song is made: the song model needs the memory. The next message opens it again.
The loudness brought to a target and the peaks held under -1 dBFS.
A chat model of the phone writes the style and the lyrics from your idea, with the section tags, the pauses and the stress marks the song model reads.
The stressed vowel of names and rare words as a capital (ФраголІно), so that the singer stresses them right.
The writer may put an [Interlude] where the voice should rest.
The model thinks before it writes: better lyrics, a longer wait.
